summary: Regression test for EditVideo defensive error handling (save/delSubtitle/setDefaultSub) and thumbnail click UX. All backend and frontend paths verified. Success path: PATCH thumbnail_url returns 200, 'Saved' toast fires, border-rose-500 CSS class moves to the clicked thumbnail. Failure path (401 unauthenticated): red 'Save failed: Authentication required' toast fires — silent-failure bug is fixed. Backend consistently returns HTTPException detail field for all error responses (401/404/400) and JSON content-type even via the public ingress URL, so future stale-frontend deploys will produce visible toasts instead of silence.

ui_bugs.issue: React console warning 'Encountered two children with the same key, other'. The <SelectItem value="other"> is hard-coded at line 292 AND already exists in COMMON_LANGS array (line 31). When the API-served /api/languages payload also contains 'other' (or when the fallback is used), the key collides. Pre-existing, not related to this iteration's fix — recommend either removing the hard-coded SelectItem or filtering it out of the languages array.

action_items: LOW: Deduplicate the 'other' language SelectItem in EditVideo.jsx (remove line 292 hard-coded SelectItem, or filter COMMON_LANGS/allLangs so 'other' isn't included when the manual one is rendered). Currently produces a React key warning but does not break functionality.

Advisory for the reported production VPS issue: the code fix is correct — advise the user to rebuild their Docker frontend image (docker compose build --no-cache frontend && docker compose up -d frontend) so the new EditVideo.jsx with try/catch + toast.error is actually served. After rebuild, any silent failure will now surface as a toast explaining WHY (401/404/500/network).
critical_code_review_comments: EditVideo.jsx save(patch): the try/catch is correct. `toast.error(`Save failed: ${msg}`)` uses backend `detail` when available. Good defensive pattern.

EditVideo.jsx delSubtitle / setDefaultSub: both now catch errors and toast. Backend endpoints confirmed to return HTTPException detail on 400/404 (unknown subtitle id, missing id field, unknown reorder id).
EditVideo.jsx line 292: hard-coded `<SelectItem value="other">` duplicates the one in COMMON_LANGS -> React key collision warning (pre-existing).
server.py:1417-1430 subtitles reorder: proper validation (400 for missing id, unknown id, missing-from-reorder). Prevents corruption of subtitle list via PATCH.
server.py:1403 PATCH /videos/{id}: uses require_user + uploader/admin guard, returns updated video with `_id` excluded — clean.

Public ingress correctly returns JSON error payload for FastAPI HTTPExceptions on PATCH /api/videos/{id} (verified via TestPublicUrlSmoke::test_public_url_patch_video_returns_json_error) — this is critical because it means the defensive toast will actually show the meaningful `detail`, not '[object Object]' or HTML garbage.

success_rate.backend: 100% (9/9 pytest tests pass, including 2 public-URL ingress smoke tests)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for the tested defensive-handling paths — thumbnail click success (200 → Saved toast → border moves) and failure (401 → 'Save failed: Authentication required' toast, border stays) both work as intended

context_for_next_testing_agent: The user's reported 'silent thumbnail click failure' on their VPS could NOT be reproduced in the preview environment because the preview always serves the latest code. The main-agent-added defensive try/catch works as intended: (a) success path unchanged, (b) failure paths now toast the backend detail. If the user still sees silence after pulling the fix, verify their Docker frontend image was rebuilt (docker compose build --no-cache frontend). Backend PATCH accepts thumbnail_url without any special validation, so 400s are unlikely — most probable production failures would be 401 (stale token), 403 (wrong uploader for a non-admin), or 404 (video id mismatch). All three now show a toast on the client. Test video 98ebab0f has 10 thumbnail_options, is uploader-owned by admin (id 237bd97e), no subtitles — good baseline for future regressions.
rca of the issue: Root cause (per main agent's diagnosis): user's VPS was running a stale Docker frontend build that did NOT include the defensive try/catch around save/delSubtitle/setDefaultSub. So thumbnail-click PATCH requests that failed silently (e.g. 401 due to expired token, or 404 due to backend/frontend version drift) produced no user feedback. Mitigation: (1) main agent wrapped save() line 106, delSubtitle() line 146, setDefaultSub() line 157 in try/catch with toast.error showing the backend detail. Verified in preview: 401 -> 'Save failed: Authentication required'; 200 -> 'Saved'. (2) User must rebuild their Docker frontend image so the new code is actually served. No code fix required in this iteration.
